Messages.Author: vermillian
Messages.Body:
I've played a meddling, and I get ousted... does meddling stay in
play?

Similarly, I'm played a meddling and the methuselah I named is ousted.
Does the meddling stay in play?

Our group has ruled yes on both accounts, saying that the card isn't
controlled by anyone.

Similarly, I suppose Reversal of Fortunes stays in play after the
person who called it is ousted... right?

~SV

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
"vermillian" <vermil...@yahoo.com> wrote in message
news:f987c6cd.02050...@posting.google.com

> I've played a meddling, and I get ousted... does meddling stay in
> play?

No.
You called the vote, you control the card.
It leaves when you do.
Same as Beyond Reproach, Camarilla Threat, Legacy of Pander,
Masquerade Enforcement, National Guard Support or Rumors of Gehenna.

> Similarly, I'm played a meddling and the methuselah I named is ousted.
> Does the meddling stay in play?

Yes.
You called the vote, you control the card.
It leaves when you do (or when a vote is called to burn it).

> Our group has ruled yes on both accounts, saying that the card isn't
> controlled by anyone.

Your group was wrong.

> Similarly, I suppose Reversal of Fortunes stays in play after the
> person who called it is ousted... right?

Reversal of Fortunes is never put into play.
The mechanic of the turn passing to the player on your
right continues until another Reversal of Fortunes
is called and passed.

Carpe noctem.

Lasombra

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
"Shaun McIsaac" asked:

> Since actions to burn cards I control are directed, would
> this make the vote to burn Meddling of Semsith directed at me?

No.

6.3.1
Political actions are never directed at a specific Methuselah,
regardless of what effect the referendum will have if it passes
(so a political action can be blocked by, and only by, the acting
Methuselah's prey and predator).

http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/rulebook/

Carpe noctem.

Lasombra
